description:
Autex Vicinity Desk Screen - Slate is a lightweight, semi-rigid acoustic
workstation screen crafted from 100% polyester fibre. Designed to be fixed
non-destructively to desks using Vicinity Workstation Clamps, the Slate design
features a clean rectangular shape with chamfered or rounded corner details that
enhance both visual and acoustic privacy. It absorbs speech-range frequencies
right where open-plan chatter starts, delivering acoustic sanctuary for focused,
independent work.

polyester acoustic screen

Slate design provides focused desk-level privacy
with clean, tailored lines

Constructed with a minimum of 80% post-consumer
recycled PET

screen)

Non-destructive fixing via Vicinity Workstation Clamps made from 100%
recycled PET

Group 1 fire rating compliant with AS ISO 9705 - 2003 and
AS 5637.1

Durable, pin-receptive, moisture-resistant, and will not slump or
fray over time

Safe, non-toxic, non-allergenic, and free of chemical binders
or formaldehyde

Certified Carbon Neutral product with third-party verified
EPD and Declare Red List Free

Available in over 20 solid Cube colours and
printed finishes

rag_summary:
Autex Vicinity -
Desk Screen - Slate is a lightweight acoustic workstation partition made
from 12mm or 24mm Cube semi-rigid polyester felt containing at least 80%

description:

this collection unites cultural storytelling and tranquil natural motifs with
certified Group 1 fire safety.

description:
Bradford Acoustigard is a premium, Australian-made
non-combustible glasswool insulation available in partition batts and rolls,
specifically engineered to deliver high-performance acoustic control in internal
partition walls. Manufactured from molten glass containing up to 65% recycled
content using biosoluble FBS-1 formulation, it provides sound transmission loss
and cavity absorption in commercial steel stud and timber wall assemblies. It is
non-combustible, low-allergen, and sized to fit standard 64mm and 92mm steel
stud walls without causing plasterboard bulge.

rag_summary:
Bradford Acoustigard is a non-combustible bio-soluble glasswool
insulation supplied in pre-cut batts and rolls, specifically formulated for
acoustic control in commercial steel stud and timber drywall partitions.
Available in densities from 11 kg/m3 to 32 kg/m3 and thicknesses of 50mm, 75mm,
and 90mm (R1.3 to R2.7), it provides high sound transmission loss (Rw 42 to 60+)
and cavity absorption. Manufactured in Australia with up to 65% recycled glass
and certified non-combustible to AS 1530.1, it fits standard 64mm and 92mm studs
snugly without bulging plasterboard linings.

description:
Bradford Anticon Roofing Blanket is a premium Australian-made
glasswool insulation blanket factory-bonded to a reflective foil laminate

condensation control in a single under-roof layer. It incorporates a 150mm foil
overlap edge to ensure a continuous vapour barrier, mitigating condensation
damage while offering bushfire ember protection up to BAL-FZ.

description:
Bradford Fibertex is a range of robust, non-combustible rockwool
(stone wool) industrial insulation boards and blankets engineered for
high-temperature and fire-critical applications. Manufactured by spinning molten
natural basalt rock and recycled slag into fine inorganic fibres bonded with a
thermosetting resin, Fibertex operates continuously at service temperatures
from 350°C up to 820°C with minimal shrinkage. It provides thermal conservation,
fire protection, condensation prevention, and acoustic absorption for industrial
process vessels, tanks, furnaces, fire-rated curtain walls, and building
envelopes.

Bradford
Fibertex is a heavy-duty, non-combustible rockwool (stone wool) board and
blanket range engineered for high-temperature industrial equipment, fire-rated
curtain walls, and acoustic enclosures. Spun from natural volcanic rock and
